I have implemented and verified the solution on the `fix/persister-restore-state` branch:

### Summary of Changes

1. **`createPersisterRestoreResult` & Query State Restoration (`@tanstack/query-core`)**
   - Exported [`createPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L168-L176) and [`isPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L178-L185) from [index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-core/src/index.ts#L13-L14) and updated [`QueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L127-L147) return types in [types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-core/src/types.ts).
   - Added [`Query.restoreState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L302-L363) and handling in [`Query.fetch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L671-L675) so returning a `createPersisterRestoreResult({ data, state })` marker adopts the restored snapshot as the active `QueryState` with `fetchStatus: 'idle'`, preserves `status`, `error`, `isRefetchError`, counters (`dataUpdateCount`, `errorUpdateCount`, `fetchFailureCount`, `fetchFailureReason`), timestamps (`dataUpdatedAt`, `errorUpdatedAt`), `isInvalidated`, `fetchMeta`, and infinite query pagination (`pages`, `pageParams`), and does not invoke `QueryCache` `onSuccess`/`onSettled` fetch callbacks.
   - Updated [`QueryObserver.createResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L502-L660) and mount fetch checks ([`shouldFetchOnMount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L371-L397), [`shouldFetchOptionally`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L357-L369)) in [queryObserver.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts) so observers mounting onto restored queries expose the persisted failure counts, timestamps, and refetch-error state instead of resetting them or treating the restored snapshot as an uncached initial mount.

2. **Fine-Grained Persister & Bulk Restoration Reconciliation (`@tanstack/query-persist-client-core`)**
   - Updated [`experimental_createQueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L187-L523) in [createPersister.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts):
     - [`persisterFn`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L299-L366) returns `createPersisterRestoreResult` when restoring from storage so single-query restoration preserves full state.
     - [`restoreQueries`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L368-L454) restores full query snapshots via `restoreState` and reconciles existing live queries via [`reconcileQueryStates`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L81-L170), merging data freshness (`dataUpdatedAt`) and error freshness (`errorUpdatedAt`) independently.

3. **Framework Adapter Support & Tests**
   - Fixed subscription fallback in [useBaseQuery.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/vue-query/src/useBaseQuery.ts#L139-L161) and [useQueries.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fo3e_2l4/packages/vue-query/src/useQueries.ts#L225-L246) in `@tanstack/vue-query` when using a core `QueryClient` instance.
   - Added unit and adapter tests across `@tanstack/query-core`, `@tanstack/query-persist-client-core`, `@tanstack/react-query`, `@tanstack/preact-query`, `@tanstack/solid-query`, `@tanstack/vue-query`, `@tanstack/svelte-query`, and `@tanstack/angular-query-experimental`.
